issue_context.title: Service call to media_player.volume_mute ignores argument is_volume_muted
issue_context.body:
### The problem

In the current [implementation](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/3e89ebb1cb531c9fe4d9ed78d22b00a764eab4d7/homeassistant/components/androidtv/media_player.py#L637) call handler ignores desired mute state instead behaving like a toggle.

I've tested this calling the service from dev tools without changing the value of ``Muted`` then observed the state of the media player attribute ``is_volume_muted``.

Dependency ``androidtv`` implements it's mute functionality like key press on a remote:
https://androidtv.readthedocs.io/en/stable/_modules/androidtv/basetv/basetv_async.html#BaseTVAsync.mute_volume

It would probably be sufficient to take a look at current state before calling ``self.aftv.mute_volume()``

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.10.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

androidtv

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/androidtv/

Hey there @jefflirion, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`androidtv`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L45) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

I've altered the code like follows:
```python
    @adb_decorator()                                                                                        
    async def async_mute_volume(self, mute):                                                                
        """Mute the volume."""                                                                              
        if mute != self._attr_is_volume_muted:                                                              
            await self.aftv.mute_volume()      
```

This now behaves as expected, however it's prone to race condition with set_volume.
If both are used as in one of the [custom components](https://github.com/mattieha/slider-button-card/blob/3cf981ae45f059ef0a98bab4087322c9591ada85/src/controllers/media-controller.ts#L17)

Code in component does not expect unmuting on volume change so it call's it on its own, however androidtv did not recieve an update yet and it does not know its already unmuted (At least that's what I think is happening).
Any ideas how to solve this properly ?
